[1/1] Deliver the reforge run-1 repairs under the ledger. Run-1 audited all 32 commits of the project's history in 11 windows and attested every hunk; it found 6 issues, repaired 4 (the warn pill CSS, the loopback base_url guard plus its regression test, the poll-loop output drain, and the eval change judge's hidden .py files), and recorded 2 for hand work (duplicate SHIM_TEXT, unignored spill sidecars). The repairs are committed as de75c38, 27fee41, 0dcfa16 and 9f497e7 by reforge, the board surface evidence for the CSS change is recorded at d3e23e5be680, and this task owns that delivery so the strict ledger check passes. No new code.
